newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Friday, buoyed by private investors' short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 1.7 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark March was up 0.8 yen at 134.8 yen.

"After most contracts hit their life of contract lows on Thursday, a perception that the market was oversold attracted short-covering," one trader said. The yen's weakness against the dollar also supported the market, they said.
"A moderate technical rally is likely next week, although any gains could be capped by profit-taking," he said.
